title: Late-Payment Points on Network and Server Order Cancellation Fees
content:
Late-payment points are added to the infrastructure fee percentage, the fee percentage charged on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, from the ClearPath late fees posted on the client's ClearPath billing fewer than twelve whole months before the day the cancellation is recorded: **3.0 points** for two or more such late fees, **1.0 point** for exactly one, and none when there is none.

The late fees counted are the late fee entries on the billing ledger of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

| ClearPath late fees posted fewer than twelve whole months before the cancellation day | Points added |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| 1 | 1.0 |
| 2 or more | 3.0 |

A ClearPath late fee posted nine months before the cancellation day counts; one posted fifteen months before does not. Points are percentage points: 15 percent with 3.0 points added is 18 percent.
